text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Once I do someone's date-of-birth 
fortune, I never forget their birthday!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a special treat today, I've 
arrived for your on-site birthday 
fortune-telling~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Wahh. For someone like me... Thank you 
so much~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then, first let's read your palm to 
see this year's fortune, and then we can 
do some physiognomy face-reading!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-You're doing three of them for me...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, we're not done yet! Flower 
fortune-telling, astrology, tea leaf 
reading—let's do them all today!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat?! Y-You're really going that far 
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Doto-san, let's make this 
the luckiest year ever together!
